name: fredis-workbench
description: FREDIS: Fragmentation with Reactions that are Externally Definable for In Silico Spectra.

commands.title: FREDIS: Edit Fragment Ion Adduct Rules

customEditors.displayName: FREDIS Fragment Ion Adduct Rule Set

fredis.pythonPath.description: Python executable used for FREDIS CLI commands.

fredis.applicationRoot.description: Workspace-relative FREDIS Python project directory. Empty enables automatic parent and mnt/app discovery.

fredis.workbench.defaultOutputDirectory.description: Default output root for preparation, training and prediction. Empty leaves output directories blank. Each new Workbench uses a named timestamp subdirectory. Relative paths are resolved against the FREDIS project.

fredis.workbench.dataDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Data Preparation forms. Edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.

fredis.workbench.trainingDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Training forms. Edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.

fredis.workbench.predictionDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Prediction forms. Edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.

fredis.workbench.spectrumViewerPageSize.description: Number of spectrum dataset rows shown per page in the Workbench Spectrum Viewer.

fredis.workbench.reactionPatternAnalysis.description: Number of compounds shown per page in Reaction Pattern Analysis.
Number of peak rows shown per page in the Reaction Pattern Analysis Compound / Peak View.
Maximum width in pixels of the SMILES column in Reaction Pattern Analysis. Full SMILES remain available from the Copy button.
